text: Yimɓe Muusaa ɓen wi'i: "Men lunndaaki fodoore maaɗa nden -an Muusaa- e yiɗi amen, ko woni ko sabu tampere, gomɗii men ronndinaama dolle tedduɗe immorde e cuɗaari yimɓe Fir'awna ɓen, men feriiɗe e nder ngayka fii seedugol e majje, ko no men feroriɗe non ka nder ngayka Saamiriiyu kadi ferori ko o jogii kon immorde e mbullaari kolce puccu Jibriila ngun (yo o his).
